scope: R213: disabling prefetch still leaves the DiT non-deterministic, refuting the R212 hypothesis

setup.offload_mode: legacy, i.e. per-block synchronous module.to() through forward pre and post hooks, no async prefetch
setup.contrast: native installs _install_layerwise_hook_group with a copy stream and asynchronous next-block prefetch
setup.cases: 3 audit cases times 3 repeats equals 9 measurements

verdict: with prefetch off and fully synchronous per-block module.to, the output still differs on every repeat, so the prefetch hypothesis is refuted
